# Support

- **Questions, bugs and feature ideas:** open an
  [issue](https://github.com/mralaminahamed/flagcast/issues/new/choose) using
  one of the templates. GitHub Discussions is not enabled for this repository.
- **Security problems:** do not open an issue; follow the
  [security policy](../SECURITY.md).
- **Contributing code:** see the [contributing guide](../CONTRIBUTING.md).
